name: Preserve Native Provider Email Mismatch
summary: Validates a provider assertion while preserving provider, registered, and invited emails as distinct evidence values when they differ; provider email remains asserted until separately verified by NuvIoT.

preconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == pending and pending-identity-flow == native-provider and registered-email != provider-email and invited-email != provider-email

setup: Create a native-provider PendingIdentity with distinct registered, provider, and invited email values.

postconditions.expression: credential-proof == native-provider-proved and email-ownership == asserted and registered-email, provider-email, and invited-email remain distinct

sourceReferences.note: Provider email may prefill or support the ceremony but never replaces independent NuvIoT email proof for identity linking.
